scenario: LSER.17.2 / LSER.10.9 — `direction` returns `Int?` (-1 / 0 / +1), and [LSER.17.2]'s Returns column is the static type of both call forms, so `t.direction == "rising"` compares an Int with a String and is a compile error ([LERR.1.1.5]). Admitted, a warm read would halt the tier at runtime as an untainted ill-typed compare ([IRET.9.6]). PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck.luni_9_1_agg_type` types `direction` as `Int?`, and `ltim_5_5_comparison` refuses it against a String; the positive counterpart is compiler/LSER.10.9, `t.direction > 0`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    direction sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where t.direction == "rising"
->
    log info "x"
